'''B3-RD''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that was tasked by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-allied forces with reprogramming artillery controlled by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Axial Park]] region of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was destroyed by Imperial [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]], but Republic forces recovered the targeting program from the droid and completed the mission.
